description: Canonical non-secret ARK rates and stat multipliers. This registry mirrors rate/stat values represented in the canonical INIs and exists so Sentinel can validate, display, diff, and manage them without using a live server as authority.
notes: Do not populate missing values by guessing.
Initial population must come from a reviewed known-good export, then Git becomes authoritative.
After bootstrap, edits are made here/canonical INIs in Git and deployed outward to servers only by explicit command.
